scope: Native local Ollama with tools.toolSearch unset; fixture schemas, not provider wire payloads

tools.name: tool_search
tools.description: Search the effective Tool Search catalog. Pass query for one search or queries for several independent searches in one call; a non-empty query joins a non-empty batch first, with its own limit. Batch results stay grouped in request order. Queries must be in English: matching is lexical against tool names and descriptions, which are written in English, so another language will usually match nothing. Pass an exact result id or name to dispatch_action. Use tool_describe when you need its input schema or when a result includes instructionsHint; call it before dispatch_action to load the complete server instructions.

query.description: Single search query, in English. A non-empty query joins a non-empty batch first. Null or blank is ignored beside a non-empty batch.

limit.description: Maximum number of single-search results. Omitted or null uses the default. With only batch queries, omit this or set it to null; set limits on each batch entry.

query.description: Search query, in English. Describe the capability you need.

limit.description: Maximum results for this query. Defaults to 5 when omitted.

queries.description: Independent searches. Prefer this alone for several searches; a non-empty query beside it runs as the first entry. Their effective limits may total at most 50; an omitted item limit counts as 5. The serialized query strings may use at most 512 UTF-8 bytes in total.

tools.name: tool_describe
tools.description: Load the full schema and metadata, including complete server instructions, for one tool id or name. Use this when the input is not already clear or when discovery returned instructionsHint.

id.description: Tool search result id or tool name.

tools.name: dispatch_action
tools.description: Call an exact Tool Search result id or name through OpenClaw. If arguments are not already clear, call tool_describe with the same id for the full description and schema; do not guess omitted fields from compact input hints.

id.description: Tool search result id or tool name.

Use tool_search for a compact input signature or tool_describe for a full schema. Deferred names are not directly callable. Call dispatch_action with the result id or name in id and all tool parameters in args. Use this wrapper even when other guidance names a deferred tool directly.
